home.heroTitle: Government forms, <1>explained and filed</1> for you.
home.heroDescription: FormSaathi listens to what you need, checks schemes you qualify for, opens the official website, fills fields from your secure vault, guides every document, and reads everything back before you submit — in the language you chose.
home.heroSubtext: Google sign-in → onboarding: pick your language (one tap), then fingerprint or skip → voice onboarding.
home.agentNarrates: Agent narrates each action · You confirm by voice
home.langSectionDesc: Tap once to use the app in the script you read every day. Intent and conversation work across eight spoken languages; the interface meets you in twelve.
home.stepsTitle: From "what do I need?" to submitted
home.stepsSubtitle: Each step is one clear action — mostly voice, always in your language.
home.step1Body: Sign in with Google through Clerk — quick, familiar, and verified.
home.step2Body: Twelve Indian languages. Tap once to hear and read everything in the script you already use.
home.step3Body: WebAuthn biometric stays only on your phone or computer. Every return visit: one touch.
home.step4Body: Six gentle questions build your profile. Scan Aadhaar with the camera to skip most of it.
home.step5Body: Ration card, crop insurance, scholarship, pension — however you phrase it, in any of eight conversation languages, FormSaathi understands.
home.step6Body: We match your profile to national and state schemes, rank by benefit value, and read results aloud. You pick one by voice.
home.step7Title: Form fill on the real portal
home.step7Body: The official government site opens. Fields fill from your vault while the agent narrates each step in your language. Missing data? Voice prompt, then saved forever.
home.step8Body: Camera opens for each required paper. Quality is checked. Uploads go to the portal and copies stay in your vault for reuse.
home.step9Body: The agent reads the completed form. You confirm by voice. Your reference number is saved to the vault.
home.sayNatural: Say it the way you naturally would
home.sayNaturalDesc: FormSaathi infers intent from everyday phrasing — not exact keywords.
home.example1: "मुझे राशन कार्ड के लिए अप्लाई करना है।"
home.vaultDesc: Biometric keys stay on-device. Answers you give once are stored for the next scheme. Documents you capture are reusable — with quality checks before anything is sent.
home.footer: FormSaathi — built for dignity, speed, and clarity on government forms.
